description: This file defines a Java interface 'JsonifiableAdaptable' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter'. The interface extends 'Adaptable' and 'Jsonifiable<JsonObject>', providing methods to convert objects to JSON with specific headers and setting headers. It also contains a nested static final class 'JsonFields' that defines static constants for JSON fields relevant to this interface.

classes.name: JsonifiableAdaptable
classes.description: A Java interface that extends 'Adaptable' and 'Jsonifiable<JsonObject>', providing methods for JSON conversion and header management.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A nested static final class containing JSON field definitions for 'topic' and 'headers'.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the object as a JsonObject with specific headers provided as argument, replacing existing headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the object, returning a new instance.
